units.source_text: 尽管他们仅有在奥地利首都的一面之交，然而如今在这种情况下，可求助的除了他以外别无旁人。

en.t: Although they had met only once in the Austrian capital, in these circumstances there was no one she could turn to except him.

units.source_text: 于是她给青年写了一封信。

en.t: So she wrote a letter to the young man.

units.source_text: 几乎与此同时，她患上了热带特有的凶猛的热病，失去了知觉。

en.t: Almost at the same time, she came down with a violent fever peculiar to the tropics and lost consciousness.
